GEO-LOWER-LEFT-FOOT.needed: Licensed left source with scale, axes, source identity and registration; no reflection.

GEO-FOOT-SESAMOID-PARTS.needed: Assign medial/lateral identities to actual right components using foot orientation and an anatomical review; store component/triangle masks with hash. Left components unavailable.

DATA-MUSCLE-BONE-LINKS.needed: Confirm whole muscle versus head-specific direct/tendinous attachments. Cuboid/cuneiform historical descriptions differ; no new muscle links accepted.

variant_decisions.decision: Already catalogued, variable; source coordinate hidden, not evidence of specimen occurrence.
Variable contacts; not compulsory relations. II metatarsal description corrected.

variant_decisions.entity: hallux sesamoid congenital absence, multipartite sesamoids
variant_decisions.decision: Typical pair documented, variants do not prove current specimen state; no generated variant mesh.

variant_decisions.entity: os peroneum, accessory navicular, phalangeal fusion
variant_decisions.decision: Not required in typical skeleton; specimen variants need source confirmation before model/card expansion.

catalogue_granularity.covered: 111 original TA terms plus 7 attachment record types; 54 owner cards (26 ordinary bones and grouped hallux sesamoids per side); 20 extra surface cards, four sesamoid constituent cards and 46 joint/group instances. 299 landmark records; no new coordinates.
catalogue_granularity.not_claimed: Exhaustive list of every articular subfacet, ligament or variant. Tarsometatarsal group relations are not all-to-all contacts. Sinus/canal separation remains SHX-tarsal-canal-vs-sinus.

CO-001.needed: Right specimen-specific independent localisation; left identified model. Right legacy marker remains hidden; left coordinate is null.

SHX-tarsal-canal-vs-sinus.needed: Resolve modern canal versus lateral sinus terminology and specimen extent independently; do not merge the two bony grooves or invent canal coordinates.
